page0.text: "Wait! Didn't you want to team up because you can't save people by yourself!?"

page1.text:
...
I stop.
Her words are like cool water on my boiling head.

page2.text: "...Sorry. But Sakura's still in danger. I know it's suicidal to go in by myself, but I don't have a choice."

page3.text:
"Yeah. If Shinji brought Sakura along, I can't help you on such short notice.
But remember, if you can somehow get Sakura away from him, I'll take care of the rest."

page4.text:
"Take care of what? Shinji?"
"Rider, not Shinji. You need a Servant to fight another Servant.
I'll be hiding as close by as possible, so just focus on saving Sakura. If you can do that, I swear I'll come rescue you, even if you're one second away from death."

page5.text:
Tohsaka says it like she's trying to convince herself.
...I know this is going to be a heavy burden on her.
I'm asking her help with that in mind, and she's promising to honor our alliance.

page6.text:
The reassurance warms my enraged heart.
I can count on Tohsaka.
In exchange, I need to get Sakura out of there unharmed.

page7.text:
"All right. I'll let you back me up."
"Good. But that's only on the condition that you stay safe and protect Sakura.
No matter how well Archer handles Rider, he can't protect Sakura at the same time. And if you give up your own life to save her, that's completely pointless."

page8.text:
There's no sign of anyone on campus.
School has been sending students home early ever since the mass comas spread.
It's almost 6:00 PM. There probably aren't even any teachers still on campus, let alone students.

page9.text:
"Do you know where Shinji is, Tohsaka?"
"...Knowing him, he'll be in the building. I bet he's set up somewhere high-up and familiar."
Only one place fits those conditions.
Shinji's in a classroom on the third floor.

page10.text:
"I'm going on ahead. Come after me once you can."
"...Yeah. I'll sneak in through the front gate once enough time passes.
I haven't told you yet, but there's a Bounded Field up around the school. They'll detect us even if we try to hide our presence, so I need you to distract Shinji and Rider."

page11.text:
I nod once and start running.
I feel hot iron enter my back.
I've already activated my Magic Circuit.
I tell my impatient self that my only weapon, Strengthening, is for protecting Sakura, not defeating my enemies.

page12.text:
"!"
I stop.
On the third floor, I find a dark-clothed Servant and Shinji with Sakura next to him. He's holding a knife, its tip pointed at Sakura.

page13.text:
"Damn you!"
I move on impulse.
My legs start sprinting again.
The dark Servant, Rider, blocks my path.

page14.text:
"Stop. We cannot guarantee her safety if you come any closer."
"Guh...!"
I force myself to halt.
My mouth hurts.
I'm grinding my teeth together so hard they're squeaking.

page15.text:
"Shinji!"
"Hey, there. You came charging in, just like I expected. Knowing you, you actually came all alone."

page16.text:
"Ngh!"
My mind goes white-hot with rage, despite my attempts to suppress it.
I feel so dizzy from anger, I almost can't see Rider right in front of me.

page17.text:
"...What's going on?"
Why is he doing this?
I'm the one who Shinji hates, right?
He didn't need to go to such lengths to call me out here.

page18.text:
Sakura is Shinji's sister.
A big brother should protect his sister.
Close family should help each other, and smile together.
So why is he doing this?
How can a big brother do this to his little sister's feelings,
when I couldn't do anything to help!?

page19.text:
"Are you serious, Shinji!?"
"Of course. That's why I'm here, waiting for you. You fallin' asleep on me now?"

page20.text:
"Guh...!"
My body leans forward.
I won't feel at ease until I run in there right now and pull Sakura away from Shinji.

page21.text:
...
But she's in the way.
Rider blocks my approach to Shinji, protecting him.

page22.text:
"...You fail to understand. What did you come here to do?
If you have come, then you must obey my Master. You should not have come alone if you intended to fight."

page23.text:
"Rgh..."
Rider's completely right.
...I need to keep a cool head.
Since I'm following Shinji's directions, I need to focus only on saving Sakura, not beating Shinji.

page24.text:
"...Whew."
I take a deep breath and relax.

page25.text:
Holding Sakura close, Shinji enjoys my apparent dismay.
...Sakura hangs her head, not looking up at me.
I'm sure she isn't unconscious, right?
She's standing on her own two legs.
She's just looking down because she can't raise her head.

page26.text:
"Shinji. Did you tell Sakura about the Holy Grail War?"
I glare at him without hiding my anger.
"Huh?"

page27.text:
"Oh, that. So that's what you're worried about!
Relax, Emiya. You didn't tell her anything, so I explained everything, start to finish! About how we're Masters who are trying to kill each other!"

page28.text:
"...!"
"Were you trying to keep it a secret? Of course it'd come out, you idiot! She knew you were hiding things from her, but she didn't ask out of respect for you!"
"Ngh!"

page29.text: Sakura turns away, gritting her teeth so that she won't look up.

page30.text:
"Ask him, Sakura. Emiya can't hide anything from you now. Go on, ask anything you want!"
...
Sakura keeps her mouth shut.
So she keeps staring at the floor because...

page31.text:
"Hm? Why aren't you saying anything?
Go ahead. Ask him for yourself what he thinks of you, whether he hates you as a filthy Matou woman."

page32.text:
"Shinji!"
She looks like she's apologizing to me. I can't take this anymore.

page33.text:
"Enough. I'm here, like we promised. Now let Sakura go."
"Huh? What promise? I ordered you to come.
All I said is that I wouldn't hurt her if you came alone."
...

page34.text: "Don't give me that look, Emiya. I'm not a monster. I'm happy that you care enough to try and take my sister back, and I'll reward that loyalty. Once this is over, you can take Sakura home with you."

page35.text:
"All right. Is that a promise?"
"Yeah. If you do what I say, I'll let her go.
It's a deal. I'll honor it."

page36.text:
"Fine. So what are your demands? Do you want me to get on my knees?"
"No need to go that far. Having a guy on his knees in front of me isn't a turn-on at all. I called you here to fight. I said we'd settle the score, remember?"

page37.text:
Rider takes a step forward.
She isn't exhibiting hostility or bloodlust.
She merely advances on her Master's orders.

page38.text:
"But a regular fight would be boring, y'know? It isn't fair because I'm not a mage, and we know you'd win in a fistfight.
So let's make this fair and have you fight her."

page39.text:
"...!"
You've gotta be kidding me.
He wants me, a regular person, to go up against Rider?
He may as well ask me to kill myself.

page40.text:
"Hey, you won't die, at least. I told Rider to hold back.
It'll be annoying to have you hanging around though, so I'll have her break a few bones."

page41.text:
...Rider isn't armed with her daggers.
Apparently, she really is holding back.

page42.text:
"Simple, right? Just let her beat you up.
Oh, but don't throw in the towel right away. If you pass out before I'm satisfied, I'm taking Sakura home with me."

page43.text:
...
Rider closes in.
In just three seconds,
I'll be within her reach.

page44.text:
"...Hmph. I'm not allowed to resist, but I can't go down easily, either?
You're contradicting yourself, Shinji. What do you want?"

page45.text:
"Isn't it obvious!?
I just want to kick the shit out of you!!!"

page46.text:
Rider pounces.
...
I raise my hands and brace for a beating.
Instantly,
a shocking impact pierces my right arm, threatening to tear off my shoulder.

page47.text:
"Guh!"
She targeted my arm which was protecting my head.
It's still attached. Nothing's dismembered yet.
But it's completely paralyzed, and I can't feel a thing.

page48.text:
"Hah...!"
I force myself back to my senses.
Unarmed, I don't have a chance in hell.
I need to Strengthen something and protect myself if I want to stay in one piece.
The next attack will finish me if I can't at least turn my thin school uniform to iron or at least harden my defenseless body!

page49.text:
"Rrgh!"
My left arm protecting my head dips.
The sledgehammer-like strike smashes through my Strengthened clothes and nearly breaks my limb.
"Hah! Damn...it...!"
In the space of a single breath, she disabled both of my arms.
...No, I can still move them, but I can't feel anything.
With reactions this sluggish, I can't use my arms to protect myself from Rider anymore.
If she goes for the face next, it'll be an instant knockout!

page50.text:
Rider is merciless.
She rains down fists on me, following Shinji's orders.
The mechanical way she does it makes her seem like a machine spinning its arms.

page51.text:
"Ah! Guh!"
With arms that can't move properly, I do my best to guard my face.
Rider's fists were never something I could predict and block, anyway.
I just need to focus on protecting my head so that I don't get knocked out.

page52.text:
"Ngh! Kuh!"
What is Rider thinking, I wonder?
She doesn't go for the numerous gaps in my defense.
All she does is keep pounding my arms and unprotected stomach.
...The agony is enough to make me faint, but it isn't the same force that rendered my arms numb.

page53.text:
"..., ..."
...That's weird.
I saw how strong Rider was at Ryudou Temple. She could have cut me in half, if she wanted.
Maybe she's just holding back, like Shinji said.
She might be avoiding my head to keep from knocking me out too early, but this still isn't like her.

page54.text:
"Ngh..."
In fact, she's an order of magnitude weaker.
The raw magical energy that Servants give off is enough to make my skin crawl.

page55.text:
At Ryudou Temple, Rider was a formidable Servant.
But the Rider attacking me now is the same Rider who lost to Saber in the park.
I don't know why that is, but this is my chance to turn the tables on Shinji!

page56.text:
"Guogh, buh!"
I stumble forward.
Like someone tired of beating on a sandbag, Rider steps in and lays a heavy uppercut into my stomach.
...
It's like a pile driver, hollowing out my insides.
...That one really hurt.
My not-yet healed injuries from last night scream out in pain.
The blow makes me vomit gastric juices, and I go weak at the knees.

page57.text:
"Done so soon, Emiya? You gotta man up in front of Sakura. You look like a total loser!"
I feel myself pitch forward.

page58.text:
...
Rider backs off slightly and watches me collapse.

page59.text:
But, I...
"Nnngh...aaahhh!"
I grab Rider's arms and force myself to keep standing.

page60.text:
"Ha! Nice, Emiya! You're as stubborn as a cockroach!
Ahaha, you're freakin' hilarious!"
Argh...
Damn, that one really got me good. I'm dizzy, and I didn't even get hit in the head.

page61.text: "Ahh, but that was a third-rate show. You're just going to keep showing me the same thing over and over. I'm getting bored, so let's wrap this up with a dramatic KO."

page62.text:
The same thing?
You've got to be kidding.
Our positions are completely different now.
Can't he even tell that our positions are reversed since I pulled myself up using Rider's arms?

page63.text:
"The distance is about five meters. Your endurance has won you this battle."
"Huh?"
I look up.
What did Rider just say to me?

page64.text:
"Break's over. Time for round two, Emiya."
Rider shakes off my hands.
The Servant in the black dress resumes her robotic assault.

page65.text:
I'm driven backwards.
Each of Rider's strikes avoids any vital points that would end the fight.

page66.text:
...
I'm numb all over.
Internal bleeding forms dark bruises where she hits me, and I can't even feel the pain anymore.
It's because the pain lingering inside me is stronger than the external pain she's inflicting.
Rider is mercilessly destroying my body from within.

page67.text:
"Prepare yourself."
The Servant utters emotionlessly and moves in.

page68.text:
That's when I fully understand—
This isn't what Shinji wants.
She isn't avoiding aiming for my head
or leaving me just barely mobile
because Shinji ordered her to...

page69.text:
"No need to hold back anymore! Kill him, Rider!"
"...!? Shinji, stop...!"

page70.text:
Rider takes a step forward, her long hair dancing through the air.
Then, she hits me with a thrust to the chest unlike anything I've experienced so far.

page71.text:
"GUH—"
I can't breathe.
My feet leave the ground.
I nearly black out from the punch, even though I saw it coming.

page73.text:
Rider sends me flying. As I sail through the air, I hear a muffled scream and a delighted guffaw.
...Sakura's voice is much closer now.

page74.text:
I fall.
On any other day, I would be dead as soon as I hit the floor.
She wouldn't even need the impact of the fall to kill me.
It's an attack that sent a whole human being flying.
I'd expect it to punch a gaping hole through my chest on impact.

page75.text:
"...Hah."
But I'm still alive.
She went out of her way to time the punch so perfectly, anyone could've jumped back at the same time.
That attack wasn't meant to kill me.
Ultimately, it was Rider, not Shinji, who decided to avoid hitting me in the face and keep attacking me in a way that allowed me to keep moving.

page76.text:
"Here goes..."
I'm at a perfect distance.
Just before I hit the ground, I twist my body in midair, and...

page77.text:
"Huh?"
...grab the knife blade in front of me with my left hand.

page78.text:
My left palm wraps around the blade.
It's already numb, so the sensation of metal cutting flesh doesn't bother me.

page79.text:
"Eh? Wha!?"
I bring my right arm around in a wild swing.
Paying no heed to my left hand being sliced open,
I slug Shinji squarely in the face with my clenched right fist.
